_what: The DATA the three modules here read: `sync_status` (do-work/drive-sync-status.mjs), `peers` (do-work/lan-peers.mjs) and `folder_bindings` (do-work/folder-bindings.mjs), moved from old trillion computer/trillion-drive.json. The old Drive's own listen addresses are left out: whoever hosts these modules names where it listens.

sync_status._what: The drive's one sync status record (do-work/drive-sync-status.mjs). `states` is checked in order and the first row whose every `when` condition holds is the state; a condition is { fact, equals } or { fact, at_least } over the facts checked (the change feed was ever answered), reached (Trillion answered the last ask), moving (saves not yet in Trillion), conflicts and failed (saves kept aside). `said` is filled with {moving} {conflicts} {failed} {cause}. `causes` files a failed ask: the first row whose `statuses` holds the answer's status, whose `status_at_least` it reaches, or `without_status` when no answer came at all; otherwise `cause_otherwise`. `cause_words` names each cause for a person.

states.said: Reading your files from Trillion for the first time.
{cause} {moving} saves wait on this computer and go up when Trillion answers.
{cause} Folders show what this computer kept.
{conflicts} saves changed in Trillion first; your bytes were kept beside them.
{failed} saves could not reach Trillion and are kept on this computer.

cause_words.signed_out: This computer is no longer signed in to Trillion.
cause_words.busy: Trillion asked this computer to wait.
cause_words.trillion_unavailable: Trillion is not answering right now.
